plan.cache_rule: each auto arm has its own cache file per run and condition, deleted at the condition start and carried across all blocks (p17/p11/p15 semantics); cold conditions delete both caches before every 8-connection segment; on resume the caches are restored from the last journaled block
plan.imputation: primary metric = mean over all planned trials; failed or missing trials count as 10000 ms (client timeout)
plan.ordering: Williams sets W2=(AB,BA), W3=(ABC,BCA,CAB,CBA,BAC,ACB). Schedule conditions: block (cycle c, stratum s) uses W[(s*cycles+c) mod |W|], run cycle-major like p17. Block and cold conditions: block b uses W[b mod |W|] (AB/BA alternation).

rules.j3_pred_pre_ms: posterior-expected J3 of the chosen action at decision time, without the guard penalty (v3.1 spec 4)
rules.guard_alarm: the chosen action was alarmed at decision time (v3.1 spec 4)
rules.reeval: the decision was a 16th-condition re-evaluation that chose the nominally 1-RTT candidate with the lowest expected J (v3.1 spec 3, why3 = reeval)
rules.guard_resid_ms: HCT minus j3_pred_pre_ms as the policy recorded it; null for failed connections (v3.1 learning has no HCT imputation) and for decisions without j3_pred_pre_ms; null rows are not counted
rules.guard_common_ms: median of the destination's common-delay window at decision time (after the 64-decision refresh, before this connection's observation)
rules.guard_alarmed_actions: number of alarmed actions for the destination at decision time (after the refresh, before this connection's observation)
rules.guard_resid_missing_ok_rows: successful rows with a finite j3_pred_pre_ms but no finite guard_resid_ms; should be 0
rules.note: descriptive v3.1 guard report; not part of any H family
